en: The image shows an old black-and-white postcard featuring a long, pavilion-style building on the water's edge, surrounded by trees. The card has handwritten Spanish text across the front and is labeled at the top with 'BALNEARIO DE LA TOJA-PONTEVEDRA-ESPANA. — SERIE A NO. 9'. The bottom left credits the 'Biblioteca de Galicia'. The typewritten caption at the bottom reads: 'VISTA GRAL. DEL EXTREMO SUR DE LA ISLA TOMADA DESDE EL MAR.'
